paite: Huchi in mipite amuh in tang a paitou in atu a, akiang ah anungzuite hong pai uhi.
heading: Jesu Tang Tung Thugente / (Luk 5.1-7.29)

paite: Huan thu agen a, amaute thu ahilh hi.
"Lungsim a gentheite ahampha uh, van-gam amaute a ahi ngal a.
heading: Kipahna Dik / (Luk 6.20-23)

paite: Lungkhamte ahampha uh, khamuan a om ding ahi ngal ua.
Thunuailutte ahampha uh, leigou luah ding ahi ngal ua.
Diktatna lunggulh a gilkial leh dangtakte ahampha uh, tai ding ahi ngal ua.
Zahngaitheite ahampha uh, zahngaihna mu ding ahi ngal ua.
Lungsim a siangthoute ahampha uh, Pathian mu ding ahi ngal ua.
Lemna bawlte ahampha uh, Pathian tate chih ding ahi ngal ua.
Diktatna ziak a sawina thuakte ahampha uh, van-gam amau a ahi ngal a.
"Mi'n keimah ziak a ahon tai ua, ahon sawi ua, zuau a gilou chiteng a hon hek hun chiang un, na hampha uhi.
Kipak unla, nakpitak in nuam un, van ah na kipahman uh athupi ngal a; huchi mah bang in na ma ua zawlnei omte leng ana sawi zel uhi.
"Lei chi na hi uh, himahleh chi peng taleh, bang in ahia ahih al nawn ding? Paihkhiak a mihingte chilgawp ding louh ngal, bangmah ding in aphatuam kei hi.
heading: Chi Leh Vak Etsakna / (Mar 9.50; Luk 14.34-35)

paite: "Khovel vak na hi uh. Mual tung a khopi om selguk theih ahi kei.
Mi'n khawnvak de in loh nuai ah akoih ngei kei ua, akoihna ah akoih zaw uhi. Huchi in insung a om tengteng atanvak hi.
Huchi mah bang in, na vak uh mite mitmuh ding in vak hen, huchi in na thil hoih hihte uh amu ding ua, na Pa uh van a om apahtawi thei ding uhi.
"Dan hiam zawlneite thu hihmang ding a hong pai in hon ngaihtuah kei un; hihmang ding a hong pai ka hi kei a, hihtangtung ding a hong pai ka hi zaw hi.
heading: Dan Leh Zawlneite Thu

paite: Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, lei leh van aman ma, avek a atunkim masiah uh dan thu a sutvom neuchik hiam, thaivom neuchik hiam, khat leng amang kei hial ding.

Huchi in kuapeuh hiai thupiak neupente lak a khat bohsia a, huai zui dia mite thuhilh peuhmah, van-gam ah mineupen akichi ding; himahleh kuapeuh zui a thuhilh behlapte, van-gam ah milian akichi ding hi.
Na diktatna un laigelhmite leh Pharisaite diktatna akhup kei in zaw van-gam ah na lut kei hial ding uh chih ka hon hilh ahi.
"Nidanglai a mite kiang ah, 'Tual na that ding ahi kei,' kichi leh, 'Kuapeuh tualthat vaihawmna a ding in lauhuai in a-om ding, kichi na zata uh.
heading: Hehna Leh Thangpaihna / (Luk 12.57-59)

paite: Ke'n zaw, kuapeuh a-unau tung a heh vaihawmna a ding in lauhthawnhuaitak in a-om ding. Kuapeuh a-unau selphou vaihawmte hawmsak a om lauhthawnhuaitak in a-om ding; 'Nang mihai' chi kuapeuh Gehenna mei a paih lauhthawnhuaitak in a-om ding uh, chih ka hon hilh ahi.
Huaiziak in maitam a na thilpiak na lat lai a na unau in na tung ah lung hihlouhna anei chih na theihkhiakleh,
huai maitam ma a na thilpiak nusia in pai inla, na unau kilempih in, huai zoh in na thilpiak lan in.

Na langpa toh vaihawmna inn zuan a lampi a na paikhawm lai un kilempih in, huchi lou in zaw na langpa'n thukhenmi khut ah hon pe dia, thukhenmi'n mimanpa kiang ah hon pe dia; suangkul ah hon khum kha ding hi.
Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, paihsa san khat nangawn na piak kim masiah huai a kipan in na pawtkhe kei hial ding hi.
"Nidanglai mite'n 'Ang na kawm ding ahi kei' achih uh na zata uhi.
heading: Angkawm Thu A Sinsakna

paite: Himahleh ke'n zaw kuapeuh etlahna lungsim toh numei en in, alungsim in angkawm ahi chih ka hon hilh ahi.
Na mit taklam in hon hihpukleh, khelkhia inla paihmang in; na pumpi Gehenna a pai sang in na pumpi a hiang khat manthat nang a ding in ahoihzaw hi.
Na khut taklam in hon hihpukleh, tankhia inla paihmang in; na pumpi a Gehenna a pai sang in, na pumpi a hiang khat manthat nang a ding in ahoihzaw hi.
"Kuapeuh zi ma in kimakna lai akiang ah pia heh, leng akichi.
heading: Kimak Thu A Thuhilhna / (Mat 19.9; Mar 10.11-12; Luk 16.18)

paite: Ke'n zaw kuapeuh kingaihna ziak hilou a zi ma in amah angkawmsak ahi, kuapeuh maksa nei nawn angkawm ahi chih ka hon hilh ahi.
"Nidanglai in mite kiang ah, 'Zuau in kichiam ke'nla, Toupa kiang ah na kichiamnate tangtun zaw in,' akichi chih leng na zata uhi.
heading: Kichiam Thu A Thuhilhna

paite: Ke'n zaw ka hon hilh ahi, chiam himhim kichiam kei un; van lou in kichiam kei un, huai Pathian laltutphah ahi ngal a; lei lou in kichiam sam kei un, huai akhe ngakna ahi.
Jerusalem lou in kichiam sam kei un, huai Kumpipa thupitak khopi ahi.
Na lutang lou in na kichiam ding ahi sam kei, samzang khat lel leng na hihngou in, na hihvom thei ngal kei uhi.
Na thugen uh, 'Ahi, hi henla,' 'Hilou, hilou,' hi vanglak hen, akan-aval zaw gitlouhna asuak ahi.
"Mit sik in mit, ha sik in ha, akichi chih na zata uhi.
heading: Phulakna Thu A Thuhilhna / (Luk 6.29-30)

paite: Ke'n zaw ka hon hilh ahi. Migilou nang kei un; na taklam biang bengte, alehlam leng doh zaw un.
Kuapeuh in na lak ah thusia bawl ut in, na puanak lak atupleh, na puanza leng lasak ngal in.
Huan mel khat pai dia hon phut kiang ah mel nih pai in.
Ahon ngen kiang ah pia inla, nang lak a leitawi nuam kiheisan ke'n.
"Na vengte it inla, na melmate hua in, akichi chih na zata uhi.
heading: Melmate Itna / (Luk 6.27-28; Luk 6.32-36)

paite: Ke'n zaw ka hon hilh ahi, na melmate uh it unla, hon sawite thumsak un.
Na Pa uh van a om tate na hihtheihna ding un. Ama'n migiloute leh mihoihte tung ah anisa asuaksak a, midiktatte leh diktatloute tung ah leng vuah azusak hi.
Nou hon itte kia na it un, kipahman bang ahia na muh ding uh? Siahkhon mite'n leng huchibang in ahih sam kei ua hia?
Huan na unaute kia uh chibai na buk un bang na hihtam tuan ua ahia? Zentelte'n leng hichibang in ahih sam kei ua hia?
Huchi in na Pa uh van a om ahoihkim sipsip bang in na hoihkim sipsip ding uh ahi."
